text:
Predicates:
PlayedFor(x, y) ::: x played for y.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in y.
KnownAs(x, y) ::: x is commonly known as y.
LoanedOut(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to y.
Nationality(x, y) ::: x's nationality is y.
Club(x, y) ::: x plays for y.

Premises:
BornIn(ailton, 1995) ∧ KnownAs(ailton, ailton) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is known as Ailton.
PlayedFor(ailton, nautico) ::: Ailton plays for Nautico.
LoanedOut(ailton, braga) ::: Ailton was loaned out to Braga.
Nationality(ailton, brazilian) ::: Ailton is a Brazilian footballer.
Club(nautico, football_club) ∧ Club(braga, football_club) ∧ Club(fluorescence, football_club) ::: Nautico, Braga, and Fluminense are football clubs.

Conclusion:
PlayedFor(ailton, fluminense)
